value.text: Reopened after a real non-git tracker reproduction of a remaining identity-class blocker. A receipt captured from an actual successful consolidation is placed as a pending intent; an independent native edit changes the survivor to Native C and then restores its prior body while Date is fixed. The complete SDK content hash returns to its original value, but immutable history grows by two. Current consolidate replay accepts the old semantic-plus-time digest, overwrites the restored native body with the frozen merged payload, and cancels the source. This is a package receipt protocol gap, not a claim that the SDK lacks an API. test/merge-revision-blocker.test.ts retains the failing regression. Fix needs a versioned receipt with immutable source/target generations, durable publication evidence, and an explicit legacy read/evaluate/export compatibility corpus; no existing history may be rewritten. PR #15 remains blocked, and no code from this round is pushed.
